description: Update a license key's activation limit, expiry date, or disabled status. Setting `disabled: true`, changing `activationLimit`, or changing `expiresAt` can revoke customer access and is treated as destructive (rate-limited and audited); `disabled: false` alone is not.

activationLimit.description: Maximum number of activations allowed. Pass null for unlimited.

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this license key

expiresAt.description: Expiry date (ISO 8601 format). Set to null to remove expiry.

licenseKeyId.description: The license key ID to update

name: ls_update_license_key
